title: GitLab CI: Prep for 3.6 end of support.
description:
Switch the Linux jobs to our 2024-Q1 image tags. Disable the Windows,
macOS and other jobs, along with file uploads.

GitLab CI: Prep for 3.6 end of support

Switch the Linux jobs to our 2024-Q1 image tags. Disable the Windows,
macOS and other jobs, along with file uploads.
